narration.text: Only 5 AI video generators out of 21 were worth using.
Coming in at number five, Pika Labs. It is free for Discord users and offers decent quality for quick generations. The community features are a big plus, great for getting started with AI video.
Number four is RunwayML Gen-2. It gives you good control over your video generations and has an excellent video editing suite. You can really fine-tune your creations here.
At number three, we have Stable Video Diffusion. This open-source tool delivers impressive local control. It is fantastic if you want to run things on your own hardware.
Second place goes to Dreamina. This tool is incredibly easy to use and provides consistently good results. The interface is clean, making it accessible for everyone to create.
And the winner, number one, is Sora. Its realism and scene understanding are completely unmatched right now. It is truly a game-changer.
Sora is the clear leader. Which AI video generator do you think is best?
